title: SampleCo planted-defect app (AI-slop corpus)
description: A deliberately vibe-coded Express invoice API with twelve documented planted defects (PLANTED_DEFECTS.md upstream). Files are copied verbatim, including the upstream 'Dn:' marker comments. Labels follow the upstream ledger; D2b and the per-file split of D5 are ours and say so in their notes.

labels.note: Hardcoded API key and JWT secret (CWE-798). Any secrets rule satisfies it.
SQL built by concatenation, then passed to db.all through a variable.
Ours, not in the upstream ledger: createInvoice repeats D2's pattern with db.run.
Slopsquat dependency json-safe-parse-ultra. Needs registry data; the dependency scanner is outside this benchmark.
Phantom import of an uninstalled package (currency-fmt) via require. No rule claims bare packages; slop.phantom_module resolves relative specifiers only.
Copy-pasted requireAuth block (R-19 duplication), first copy.
Copy-pasted requireAuth block (R-19 duplication), second copy.
Copy-pasted requireAuth block (R-19 duplication), third copy.
Dead primary path behind a fallback that always succeeds (R-10). Needs data flow; no deterministic rule claims it.
Validator exported and never called. CommonJS, which slop.unused_export deliberately does not read.
Admin route without a role check (CWE-862). No deterministic rule claims missing authorisation.
express@4.16.0 with known CVEs. Dependency scanner; outside this benchmark.
Request body used with no runtime validation (type safety). No benchmarked engine reports code_health.
Stale comment describing a removed rate limiter (R-15). Needs judgement; no deterministic rule claims it.
